👔 Portfolio Managers, Wealth Groups, Trading Firms & 5,200 Robot Traders

Every new game procedurally generates 80 Wealth Management Groups, 80 Trading Firms, 1,000 Ranked Portfolio Managers, 1,000 Ranked Traders, and 5,200 Randomly Generated Robot Traders. Standard Professional Groups, Firms, PMs & Traders require $500,000+ Net Worth, while Elite Groups, Firms, PMs & Traders require $10,000,000+ Net Worth. Robot Traders (5,200 Bots) can be rented by any player from below $10/month ($4.99/mo) to over $1,000/month ($1,050–$2,450/mo) depending on their win rate. Robot Traders execute many small trades very often to target up to 2x a year: each winning trade gains +0.10% to +0.30% while a losing trade can lose up to -1.00% (taking 1–12 small winning trades to recoup a loss, without easily blowing up your account). Use the Robot Win-Rate Filters below (Below 50%, Over 50%, Over 60%, Over 70%, Over 80%) to filter out bad bots!

🏪 Real-World Small Businesses ($50,000 – $10,000,000 • 8%–18% Cash Flow)

All 52,000 randomized small businesses are automatically managed by their own internal management teams (handling staff, insurance, customer acquisition & lawsuits automatically — not by players). Prices reflect real-world valuations starting at $50,000 for a newly built shop with no customer base yet (e.g., a newly built Nail Salon at $50K) up to 3x+ ($150,000+) for a well-managed established Nail Salon with loyal clientele. Profitable businesses generate 8%–18%/yr net cash flow (higher cash flow = higher valuation). Businesses losing money (negative cash flow) see their prices drop: some turn around to positive cash flow, while others go bankrupt due to lack of customers, mismanagement, or lawsuits. Pay a 1% Due Diligence Fee (e.g., $1,000 on a $100,000 business) to unlock a 30-day Financial Report covering 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, 2Y, 3Y, 5Y, and 10Y financials before buying!
